headline: Gilcrease Museum to Reopen in New Building in 2027
summary: Tulsa, Oklahoma’s Gilcrease Museum is scheduled to reopen in March 2027 in a new, purpose-built home, following a multiyear closure. Renovations will also improve the integration of the Helmerich Center for American Research and the Thomas Gilcrease House, which are constituent parts of the Gilcrease Museum. Set on 460 acres in the Osage Hills northwest of downtown Tulsa, the Gilcrease campus additionally includes fourteen miles of trails.

headline: Chalk Drawing Found in Private Collection Attributed to Manet
summary: A red chalk drawing of a crouching child was recently attributed to the French modernist Edouard Manet. UV analysis revealed Manet’s studio stamp in the lower right-hand corner of the drawing—additional proof for Manet’s authorship comes in the scores of similar red-chalk preparatory sketches he made in the mid-nineteenth century. Beeny also hopes the drawing will be included in the next edition of Manet’s catalogue raisonné.
